known_defect.candidate_status: D14 candidate is not GPU-verified or accepted.
known_defect.description: For a true prefix hit whose remaining extension enters layer-major chunking, _build_layer_major_chunks uses cached_len=lo and loses origin>0 on its first child. FLA is initialized without restored state, GDN recurrent/conv state is fresh, and PLE ngram context resets at EOS.
known_defect.scope: Single-request extension beyond the 4096 prefill budget; short hot continuation may also be affected by the separate wrong-donor snapshot defect.
